intent: Design a set of design tokens and a style guide page for a fintech brand that feels trustworthy.

spec.goal: Create a set of design tokens and a style guide page that give a fintech brand a trustworthy visual feel.
spec.deliverable: A set of design tokens (such as colour, typography and spacing) plus a style guide page that documents them.
constraints: The visual style must convey trustworthiness appropriate to a fintech brand.
The style guide page must document the design tokens that are delivered.
Do not invent a brand name, audience or tech stack that was not given.
done_criteria: A set of design tokens is provided covering the core visual foundations of the style.
A style guide page presents and explains the tokens.
The overall look and feel reads as trustworthy and suited to fintech.
The style guide page and the tokens are consistent with each other.
spec.summary: You want design tokens and a style guide page that make a fintech brand look and feel trustworthy.
